%%
One note of this type, `docs/direction.md`: where the factory is going, the stages it goes in, and what makes a stage reached. It is read at every version boundary and amended only when a decision changes, so the file's history is the history of the direction and each amendment carries the evidence that moved it.

It holds only what the vault cannot derive. Status, what is done, the version in flight and the backlog are computed from the seeds, the tags and the version notes; restating any of them here makes a second source of truth that drifts, and the first disagreement is a fault in a document no test reads.

Thesis: what we believe, and what would show it wrong.
Stages: for each, what the commissioner brings, what the factory supplies, and what must be true to say the stage is reached. A stage without that last sentence is an aspiration and cannot be planned against.
Decisions: dated, each with the evidence that moved it, so a settled question is not reopened without new evidence.
Open questions: each with what would answer it.
Out of scope: what we decided not to build, so it is not proposed again.
